responsibility: This definition module supplies a legacy dialect compatibility type alias that defines REAL as SHORTREAL. Its responsibility is not numeric computation but source compatibility for older Modula-2 code that expects the historical REAL meaning used by legacy gm2 configurations.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface side of the LegacyReal pair: it defines the compatibility alias REAL = SHORTREAL. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/LegacyReal.mod, it is the only file that contributes the visible type definition.
